title: അടുത്ത സ്റ്റോപ്പിൽ™ Dialogue V3
principles: Write for the mouth first, subtitles second.
Spoken-world lines stay short and conversational.
Regional tags guide casting and rhythm, not phonetic misspelling.
Examiner rulebook lines are intentionally formal.
Serious crashes and pedestrian safety are never treated as parody wins.
Every line must receive native review before final recording.
Use speaker_persona for casting and bark selection; speaker remains the broad in-world role.

lines.english_gloss: Stating travel time to the exact minute may be recorded as unnecessary confidence.
